about_the_game:
Game Background

In this ancient land soaked in arcane magic, glimmering particles float in the air while mysterious energy flows beneath the earth. Legends speak of powerful magical forces hidden deep within, waiting for true explorers to uncover their secrets. You will call a team of adventurers from various professions and venture into this realm filled with mystical dangers and unknown magic. Every ounce of power you gain must be handled with care—for each spell cast might disrupt the delicate balance of magic and trigger unforeseeable consequences. Will you become the wise one who unravels the arcane mysteries, or fall victim to the very power you seek? The outcome of this journey will be shaped by your every decision.

Game Features

Innovative Gameplay Fusion: Experience a seamless blend of classic Minesweeper mechanics and rich RPG depth. Arcane cores generate energy vortices, and the strength of each vortex reveals how many cores lie nearby. Mastering this rule allows you to safely harness arcane power without triggering explosive core reactions.

Squad-Based Strategy and Growth: Recruit adventurers with unique skills and attributes to form your own squad. Enhance their abilities by absorbing arcane energy, and craft powerful team compositions and tactical strategies to dominate the field.

One-Turn Challenge: Meticulously plan every move and skill usage to attempt clearing challenges in a single turn. It’s not just a mark of power, but the ultimate test of your strategic intellect.

Begin Your Journey

Call your adventuring squad now and seek out the legendary arcane treasures! Embrace the challenge, forge your own magical legacy, and dive into a world of wonder and danger! Start your fantasy adventure today!

(The game is currently in development and testing. UI and visual effects are not in their final form. Please stay tuned for updates on our progress.)
